description: Under every assignment and surrounding placeholder tuple, \(N^+(\varphi)\) has the truth value of \(\varphi\), and \(N^-(\varphi)\) has that of \(\neg\varphi\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.nnf_realize.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'}
  {n : ℕ} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (positive : Bool) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.nnf φ positive).Realize a b ↔
    if positive = true then φ.Realize a b else ¬φ.Realize a b
